input.query: Explain the difference between gross, net, and triple-net (NNN) commercial leases.

expected_output: Gross lease: tenant pays fixed rent, landlord covers all operating expenses (taxes, insurance, maintenance). Net lease: tenant pays base rent plus some operating expenses. Double-net (NN): tenant pays base rent + property taxes + insurance. Triple-net (NNN): tenant pays all operating expenses including maintenance. NNN common in US retail/industrial. Pros/cons for each party. UK equivalent: full repairing and insuring (FRI) lease closest to NNN.
